methodologies.name: Standardized dietary pattern analysis via Cox regression and sensitivity analyses
methodologies.description: Evaluated six standardized dietary indices (DRLCD, aMED, AHEI-2010, DASH, CDAI, and E-DII) against site-specific cancer risk using progressively adjusted Cox proportional hazards regression models alongside 1-, 3-, and 5-year lagged sensitivity analyses.
conditions: cancer-free participants with at least two valid 24-h dietary assessments (n=118,056)

limitations.text: Previous studies on diet and cancer mainly examined individual dietary indices in relation to specific cancer outcomes, which limited direct comparisons across dietary patterns.

Bootstrap pairwise comparisons between dietary indices were not statistically significant, meaning results represent directional trends and are hypothesis-generating rather than evidence of dietary superiority or an optimal dietary strategy.
